claims.claim: Heavy duty 2.5 Ton manual hydraulic pallet jack
claims.evidence: Numeric marking near forks is only partially legible ('2500' or similar); capacity rating cannot be confirmed from the photo.
Photo 0 clearly shows a hand pallet truck with forks and handle, matching this claim.
No stress test, load demonstration, or build-quality close-up provided; subjective marketing term not shown.

risks.risk: True load capacity differs from stated 2.5 ton
risks.proof: Close-up, well-lit photo of the capacity plate/stamped number on the body
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified/generic capacity, not as a confirmed 2.5 ton unit

risks.risk: Hydraulic pump may leak or fail to lift/hold load
risks.proof: Video clip of the jack lifting a loaded pallet and holding it for a minute without drop
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional/worst case hydraulic condition

risks.risk: Wheels may be seized, uneven, or rusted internally affecting rolling
risks.proof: Video clip of the unit being pushed and steered across the floor

risks.risk: Hidden structural rust or cracks on underside/frame
risks.proof: Photos of the unit tilted up showing underside and chassis welds
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-plus-possible structural wear, i.e. lower end

risks.risk: Unknown fork dimensions may not fit buyer's pallets
risks.proof: Tape-measure photo showing fork length and width
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard/unconfirmed fit, buyer assumes risk

risks.proof: Any purchase receipt, service record, or seller statement on age (text/voice, treated as unverified claim only)

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the capacity plate/number on the body
Video of the jack lifting a loaded pallet and holding the load
Video of the unit rolling and steering on a flat floor
Photos of the underside/chassis for rust or cracks
Tape-measure shot of fork length and width
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a generic hand pallet truck with visible wear, rust, and an illegible capacity marking, so it can be priced at worst-case (unconfirmed capacity, uncertain hydraulic/wheel condition) pending the listed proofs.
